text:
Rowan: Quick announce — Lumen Mesh is GA for Hosted API today. Its a mesh-first streaming endpoint that does adaptive model stitching, per-tool prioritization, and deterministic partial commits for downstream pipelines. Opt-in from Console -> Endpoints. :tada:

Priya: Congrats! Does this change routing semantics for multi-tool requests?

Rowan: Yes — Lumen Mesh can fan-out to multiple model variants and stitch results back in-order. It also supports per-tool priority weights so latency-sensitive tools can preempt background ones.

Marta: Ops heads-up: short canary window planned (6h) in us-west-2. I added SLO checks to the runbook and a synthetic that validates stitched outputs + order guarantees.

eng-deploy-bot: rollout/lumen-mesh-v1: started at 3001234590 (canary clusters: us-west-2), canary_replicas=4.

Priya: Any SDK or frame changes we need to call out for Support?

Rowan: Minimal SDK patches. New endpoint `/v1/lumen/mesh-stream`. Streaming frames include `mesh_frame` types: "chunk" | "stitch_meta" | "final". Helpers: `mesh.stitch()` in JS/Py. Existing streaming calls remain supported.

Priya: Example curl for release notes?

Rowan: Short example:

Rowan: ```bash
Rowan: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"lumen-mesh-1","tools":["kb","calc"],"priority_map":{"kb":10,"calc":5},"stitch_threshold_ms":40}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/lumen/mesh-stream
Rowan: ```

Marta: infra note: added latency P50/P95 for stitched commits, stitch_error_rate and tool-priority inversion alerts. Canary health dashboard linked in the runbook.

eng-deploy-bot: rollout/lumen-mesh-v1: canary health=ok (3001234625). proceeding to eu-west-1 canary.

Priya: Billing / quotas?

Rowan: Billing counts `mesh_units` = base tokens + stitch_overhead. Default quota: 15 streaming rps per key for mesh streams; stitch_overhead capped by default. Customers can request increases via Console.

Priya: Deprecations? We should tell customers if anything's being phased out.

Rowan: We'll deprecate `stitch-proxy` in 60 days. We will auto-route only for opt-in customers and provide a migration helper script. Full timeline and compatibility notes in docs.

docs-bot: docs-bot: docs/lumen-mesh published at https://console.redwood.ai/docs/lumen-mesh — includes migration guide, examples, and quota details.

Marta: I'll schedule a 20m walkthrough for Support/CS tomorrow 9am PT and drop the playbook in the docs folder.

Rowan: Town hall Friday 11am PT for product + eng + ops Q&A. Please RSVP. Watch #eng-runtime for regressions and ping me for escalations. :rocket:
